name: TJX Rewards Platinum Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase APR is prime + 23.74% (30.49% as of January 1, 2026); cash advance APR 34.99%; penalty APR prime + 33.74%. Cash advance fee $10 or 4%.

fx_fee.notes: The rates and fees table lists no foreign transaction fee.

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 everywhere else Mastercard is accepted.
